detailed_description:
The target video is in a Japanese school-life anime style with warm orange-red dusk light over the entire scene.
[Shot 1] A wide establishing shot frames a campus rooftop at dusk, the sky filled with orange-red sunset clouds. <Subject 2> stands on the right, the 2D anime-style girl with pink-lavender twin ponytails and amber-gold eyes, wearing the white sailor-style uniform with a dark neckerchief and a school-style short skirt; she holds both hands behind her back, tilts her head slightly, and looks toward the right with a mischievous little-devil smirk, her twin tails swaying gently in the wind. <Subject 1> stands on the left, the 2D anime-style girl with silver-white long hair and a left-side red ribbon bow, wearing the white custom jacket with gold buttons and gold-edged cuffs over a dark navy top with a white stand collar and a red bow, the black pleated skirt, white over-knee socks, and black leather shoes; she leans lightly against the metal rooftop railing. The camera slowly pushes in toward the two girls with a small amplitude, while the breeze lifts the edges of their hair and clothing. The open wind and the faint school end-of-day broadcast fill the air, with the soft rustling of hair and fabric.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot pushing in at normal speed toward <Subject 2> (S1), the pink-lavender twin-tailed girl in the white sailor uniform from [Shot 1], still holding her hands behind her back and tilting her head while her gaze stays toward the right side of the frame. A playful teasing smirk crosses her face, and her twin ponytails sway lightly in the wind. Using the bright, mischievous voice timbre referenced from <Audio 2>, she asks in a brisk light tone, <d>[Chinese] 姐姐，明天的约定，你没有忘记吧？</d> After the line, her lips close into the same teasing smile. The wind and the distant broadcast continue, with the soft rustle of her twin tails and skirt.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1> (S2), the silver-white-haired girl in the white-and-gold jacket from [Shot 1], on the left side of the frame facing right toward Yuki. She lowers her head slightly, then raises it with a soft smile, her silver-white hair and the red ribbon bow lifted by the breeze, her right hand resting gently on the rooftop railing. Using the calm, clear voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, she replies in a soft even tone, <d>[Chinese] 嗯，我记得呢。说好了，明天见。</d> After the line, she keeps the soft smile as the wind continues and the distant broadcast fades slightly, with the sound of her hair and clothes rustling in the breeze.
